records.name: Jaunda Weiterbitte
records.biography_en: Accepts the offer enthusiastically and adds a practical complication. Her HyperNorm pompons accept every offered premise before inspection begins. A dissonant card adds something inconvenient and she tries to make room rather than erase it. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Zustimmung enthält bereits eine kleine Zusatzschwierigkeit.

variant_notes.note_en: Accepts the offer enthusiastically and adds a practical complication.

records.name: Partner Wechselweise
records.biography_en: Keeps both sides of the scene available until someone decides who is listening. His mismatched HyperNorm gloves keep two possible roles available. A dissonant card asks whether listening can count as doing something in the scene. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Partnerschaft wartet noch auf die Zuteilung des Zuhörens.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps both sides of the scene available until someone decides who is listening.

records.name: Zwischenrufer Besserwisser
records.biography_en: Has mistaken being audible for having improved the scene. His HyperNorm programme becomes a speaking tube the moment somebody else begins. A dissonant card asks what he heard before deciding to interrupt. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Verbesserung setzt die Unterbrechung voraus.

variant_notes.note_en: Has mistaken being audible for having improved the scene.

records.name: Mikrofürst Ganzkurz
records.biography_en: Needs only one more minute and everybody else's remaining evening. His microphone holds the HyperNorm floor long after the promised minute. A dissonant card remains quiet without surrendering its place. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der kurze Zusatz nimmt den verbleibenden Abend in Anspruch.

variant_notes.note_en: Needs only one more minute and everybody else's remaining evening.

records.name: Requisiteurin Irgendwas
records.biography_en: Finds exactly the wrong object with enough conviction to make it useful. Her HyperNorm bag contains three wrong objects for every correct situation. A dissonant card suggests that the scene could change to welcome one. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Requisite wurde mit hinreichender Überzeugung für passend erklärt.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds exactly the wrong object with enough conviction to make it useful.

records.name: Lichtwart Ausjetzt
records.biography_en: Can end a difficult scene without resolving a single difficulty. His HyperNorm lever ends every unresolved scene as a technical necessity. A dissonant card asks whether the people remain there when the lights go out. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Schwierigkeit bleibt nach Ausschalten weiterhin unbeleuchtet.

variant_notes.note_en: Can end a difficult scene without resolving a single difficulty.
